headline: L&T homes at Hebbal, where the airport road begins.
pitch: Olivia is part of L&T Realty's Raintree Boulevard at Hebbal, on Bellary Road. Hebbal is the gateway between the city and the airport, and it is set to become a metro interchange.

reasons.title: On the airport metro corridor
reasons.text: Trial runs on the Blue Line began in November 2026. Its station list includes Hebbal, Kodigehalli, Jakkur Cross and Yelahanka on the way to the airport.

reasons.title: Between the city and the airport
reasons.text: This stretch of Bellary Road sits between Hebbal and the airport, close to the Manyata office district. Buyers get airport access without leaving the city.

reasons.title: More metro is approved
reasons.text: The Orange Line (Kempapura to JP Nagar, 32.15 km) was approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024 and meets the airport line near Hebbal.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: Jobs are moving north
reasons.text: The KIADB Aerospace Park covers nearly 950 acres of aerospace manufacturing and testing next to the airport.

upcoming.status: Trial runs began November 2026. 38.44 km from KR Puram to the airport via Hebbal and Yelahanka. Overall construction was 72% in August 2026; completion is reported for December 2027.
upcoming.why: A metro within reach turns a car-only address into a commuter address.
upcoming.source: IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; Oneindia, 2026

upcoming.what: Orange Line metro (Kempapura to JP Nagar 4th Phase)
upcoming.status: 32.15 km, 22 stations. Approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024; scheduled completion 2031.
upcoming.why: A western ring of metro that links Hebbal, Peenya and JP Nagar without going through the centre.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: Proposed 37 km line with 28 stations. Karnataka Cabinet approved it in December 2024; central approval was awaited. The revised project report targets April 2033.
upcoming.why: Hebbal would become a meeting point of three metro lines.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: Kempegowda International Airport keeps adding capacity, with an Airport City business district around it.
upcoming.why: Market reports name airport expansion as the main engine of housing demand in North Bengaluru.

timelineSource: Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Oneindia, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: The metro is in trial runs, not yet open. Buyers who come in now choose before the line changes how this address is reached.

area.name: Hebbal
area.source: Square Yards property rates page, read 26 Nov 2026. Asking prices from listings, not registered sale prices.
